text:
jay (support): FYI: Acme oncall reporting a spike of 429s & timeouts on Dedicated us-west-2. They say it started ~10:20 UTC after a batch of long-context traffic. Repro notes below.
acme-oncall (customer): We're seeing lots of 429 + occasional 401s during bursts. Clients send long contexts (~40k-60k tokens) and some ETL jobs run at the same time.
jay (support): Confirmed it's Dedicated tenant.id=acme-42. Collecting logs and metrics now. Can @maria or @alex take a look at KV eviction trends?
deploy-bot: ALERT: kv_cache.evictions_rate=1180/s (↑8x), kv_cache.mem_frag=0.68, cluster.autoscaler.downscale_events=3@10:18-10:22
maria (sre): Looks correlated: autoscaler performed rapid scale-in while eviction rate was climbing. Also saw auth-proxy 504s at 10:19 which caused client retries -> amplification.
alex (runtime-eng): If nodes are drained while KV caches are hot, requests will rebuild caches (rehydration storm) causing CPU + memory pressure and more evictions. We should repro with a tenant load generator; immediate mitigations: delay downscale, throttle tenant, or increase min_replicas.
priya (billing): Noting sudden token usage spike for acme-42. Retries could produce billing anomalies. We should set a temporary rate cap to avoid double-billing and tell customers.
jay (support): Repro steps (safe, run in staging or during agreed window):
```bash
# simple client loop that sends large context and rapid concurrency
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -X POST https://dedicated.us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -d '{"model":"m-large","input":"'"$(python -c "print('A'*40000)")"'"}' &
done
wait
```
acme-oncall (customer): We can run that in a 14:00 UTC maintenance window. Would prefer not to affect other tenants.
maria (sre): Quick mitigations we can apply now (low risk):
- set tenant-level kv_quota to 60% for 24h
- bump dedicated pool min_replicas by +1
- enable "kv_eviction_backpressure" flag to slow request acceptance when eviction_rate > 200/s
alex (runtime-eng): Long-term fixes: make autoscaler consult kv_cache_fill and recent_eviction_rate before scaling down; add graceful cache handoff during node drain; rate-limit token-rotation retries to avoid auth storms.
deploy-bot: ACTION created INC-2026 assigned to @alex @maria @jay. Please attach heap profile and pprof when reproducing.
jay (support): I'll coordinate with Acme for repro window and collect heapdump + pprof. Uploading partial logs to the ticket now.
acme-oncall (customer): Thanks — we'll throttle client-side to 5qps for the repro window. Please confirm when you're ready and we'll trigger.
alex (runtime-eng): Acknowledge. We'll try the safe mitigations first, then repro in the window. If evictions persist, we'll temporarily pin them to a smaller model variant to reduce cache size.
priya (billing): I'll monitor for duplicate/burst billing events and set a notification if token counts spike.
jay (support): Next steps: apply kv_quota, bump min_replicas, schedule repro 14:00 UTC, gather heap + pprof, follow up in this thread. :thumbsup:
